purpose: New own-video experiment; inherited numerical values are an explicit product choice, not demonstrated universality
override_rule: replace named keys; absence inherits only within inherit_sections; all other sections below are complete policies

conventions.nonuniform_time: ODE allowed; SG only supported uniform contiguous segments
conventions.theta_range: [-pi,pi]; branch crossing invalidates local derivative unless future explicit rotational profile
conventions.phi_unwrap: separately within contiguous finite body-pair segments
conventions.theta_preview_guard: finite nonzero tip-minus-fixed-pivot and nonzero finite vertical
conventions.pre_release_relative_time: negative values allowed; only adjacent dt must be positive

ic.theta0: same historical circular median of exactly five consecutive valid frames release-5..release-1
ic.missing_or_nonrest: needs_explicit_IC; no fit until theta0_rad and omega0_rad_s at t=0 provided in Advanced or release corrected
ic.advanced: explicit finite theta0_rad,omega0_rad_s; fixed for both M0/M1; no joint_IC_optimisation_in_v1
ic.valid_mask: student base QC over whole source video before applying postrelease/fit interval mask; all-four source validity, positive geometry, radius/body gates and not user excluded
ic.consecutive: source IDs exactly r-5,r-4,r-3,r-2,r-1; strictly increasing Timeline timestamps with every adjacent dt>0; timestamp zero and negative release-relative pre-release time are allowed; all five base-QC valid; no postrelease substitution

qc.ai_likelihood: each AI point must have finite likelihood in [0,1]; no hard cutoff
qc.manual_point: finite adopted manual coordinate; confidence stays null; source retained
qc.body_reference: median of positive finite body separations in whole-video complete-four adopted frames not explicitly excluded; freeze numeric value in request
qc.mask: complete_four & point_source_valid & positive_geometry & radius_gate & body_gate & not_user_excluded
qc.theta_preview: finite tip+fixed calibration may display theta even if fit mask false; label QC excluded
qc.pivot_displacement: report in px only; no unverified drift cutoff; never dynamic pivot
qc.point_source_valid: for each current adopted role: manual => finite x/y only, AI => finite x/y and finite likelihood in [0,1]; superseded point likelihood irrelevant

derivative.contiguous: consecutive source frame IDs, QC-valid theta, strictly increasing timestamps with every adjacent dt>0 (timestamp zero allowed), no angle branch jump >pi
derivative.short_or_nonuniform: omega unavailable with reason; no gradient fallback or resampling
derivative.gap: never interpolate, bridge, compress time or differentiate across invalid samples
derivative.edge: interp edge values retained with edge_window flag first/last four frames

weighting.manual: weight=1.0 for explicitly adopted manual tip; relative analysis convention, not confidence=1
weighting.missing_ai_likelihood: exclude only currently adopted AI-sourced point with missing/nonfinite likelihood; never substitute 1; manual-sourced point ignores historical AI likelihood
weighting.source_selection: current adopted point source wins per landmark; historical/superseded AI likelihood is metadata only when adopted point is manual

fit.gate_interpretation: computational eligibility, not proof of identifiable information or model adequacy
fit.interval: default release..last source frame; Advanced may choose inclusive end frame; integration always from t=0
fit.gaps: integrate continuous ODE across gaps; residual only observed valid times; no per-segment restart
fit.sampling_warning: max adjacent source timestamp step >Tref/10 flags temporal resolution; not silently fabricated samples
fit.comparison: identical input digest, interval, fixed IC, mask, weights, sample IDs and loss; model/bounds-for-extra-parameter may differ; otherwise not comparable
fit.selection: same finite minimum-cost selection as legacy; nonconverged cannot be ranked as successful model evidence
fit.N_interval: end_frame-release_frame+1 for inclusive interval; counts every source frame, including missing/QC-excluded frames, not just adopted or sampled points
fit.valid_time_span: max(t_relative[fit_valid])-min(t_relative[fit_valid]); fit_valid=base_QC & inclusive interval; includes intervening gaps and is not contiguous-coverage proof

seeds.algorithm: legacy q/alpha1 estimator on longest contiguous uniform valid segment; tie earliest; keep original relative time
seeds.q_early_window: first 35 s measured from selected segment start; estimator receives segment-relative time only for seed calculation
seeds.starts: same deterministic M0/M1 start formula and clipping as legacy; record resolved arrays

diagnostics.new_video_gap_rule: detect within contiguous valid segments; extrema pairing never crosses gaps; halfcycle/EDP unavailable for interrupted chosen interval rather than silently inheriting ordinal pairing
diagnostics.period: linear interpolated same-direction crossing pairs with exactly one opposite crossing, within one contiguous segment; center whole selected interval mean of valid theta
diagnostics.phase_crossing_match: within corresponding source-time segments, same direction and ordinal; if direction sequences/counts differ mark unmatched and omit final drift summary
diagnostics.tail: last third of selected post-release time span: strict t>start+(end-start)*2/3; user may explicitly set start; record choice
diagnostics.tail_insufficient: unavailable; do not auto-extend or assume t>70s
diagnostics.tail_claim: late-window consistency; no assertion of small-angle regime
diagnostics.energy: e*=0.5*omega^2+q*(1-cos(theta)); q explicitly selected fitted omega2 or g/L proxy; separate labels; missing omega => missing energy
diagnostics.envelope_failure: unavailable; never historical p0 fallback as a successful envelope
diagnostics.edp_skip: explicit skip5; require >=8 remaining extrema; no skip bypass for short data
diagnostics.objective: same resolved fit request, conditional starred-damping slice; no new optimisation
diagnostics.objective_IC: use resolved fit IC directly; legacy diagnostic degree round-trip only in legacy reproduction

metrics.late_equilibrium_warning: median QC-valid finite theta in last min(5,duration) seconds of analysis interval; unavailable if no valid samples; abs(deg(median))>1 warning
metrics.early_late: first/last max(1,n_valid//3) valid samples in selected interval; preserve timestamps
metrics.nonfinite_prediction: fit failure; never silently shrink evaluation mask to finite prediction subset
